name: Urban Fantasy & Hidden Identity Revenge
description: High-satisfaction face-slapping tropes: exiled heir or reincarnated supreme lord mocks arrogance and shocks high society.
tone: empowering, action-packed, arrogant-villain karma, dramatic reveals
target_audience: Urban cultivation readers, shonen revenge story viewers
visual_style: High-contrast dynamic anime, aura glows, lavish banquet halls, shattered glass, opulent billionaire mansions

character_archetypes.protagonist: Seemingly broke youth concealing immense martial/mystic power and wealth
character_archetypes.deuteragonist: Loyal martial disciple or proud heiress who recognizes his true majesty
character_archetypes.antagonist: Snobbish young master and arrogant relatives

narrative_formula: Hook: The banquet sneers and public humiliation of the protagonist.
The Escalation: The antagonist attempts to crush him with security or debt.
The Turn: A titan of industry or supreme elder rushes into the room to bow before the protagonist.
The Face-Slap: Total reversal of fortune and shock on the crowd's faces.
Resolution: Protagonist departs into the night leaving the adversaries ruined.
